metadata.model: Primary: release-date ALFRED-vintage rolling OLS; 120-month window; 95% residual intervals
metadata.availability_note: The primary model joins documented Michigan final-release dates to ALFRED initial-release macro values available by that date. Dates are date-only; intraday ordering is not asserted. Assumed-lag and current-vintage models are sensitivities.

monitoring_cutoff.partial_month_policy: Observations dated after the cutoff are excluded; a current incomplete month is relabeled to the cutoff date and marked partial.
monitoring_cutoff.next_update: Refresh after each verified Michigan final release and major-event entry through election day; archive inputs, vintages, labels, and outputs on every run.

media_status.message: Timestamped, independently adjudicated all-field media measures are loaded.

corpus.message: Source-blinded all-field independent validation and adjudication are complete; the timestamped aggregate is descriptive, not exposure or causal evidence.

label_validation.message: Validation gate passed; adjudicate disagreements before constructing media measures.

adjudication.provenance: Consensus between two human-reviewed, non-blinded packets. This is not an independent-annotator reliability result.

historical_media.message: Historical series is ready for downstream modeling; finalized-label classifier results remain a development-set diagnostic.
historical_media.independent_validation_message: Independent-label validation and tone adjudication are complete for the original and supplemental historical samples.

third_model.message: The third required specification uses monthly point-in-time ALFRED snapshots for U-6, real disposable income, PCE prices, debt service, and the legacy three-component EPU index.

media_model.measurement_scope: Historical specification uses independently validated tone only; framing, salience, and factual calibration remain descriptive in the archive.
caveats: Forecast improvement is associational, not causal.
Seasonal sine/cosine terms are included; residual autocorrelation is reported.
Do not report media-dimension effects beyond independently validated tone.
The added controls use monthly date-only ALFRED snapshots; their release times are not intraday timestamps.

dictionary_validation.reference_status: Finalized independently labeled and tone-adjudicated reference set. This validates tone only; other coding dimensions require their own adjudication.
dictionary_validation.evaluation_protocol: Fixed, transparent context-aware dictionary rules. This is a development-set diagnostic; reserve a separate held-out labeled set for a final performance claim.

dictionary_invariance.note: Context-aware dictionary baseline v3. Actor and outlet masking are diagnostic checks, not a proof of fairness or invariance for a production model.

full_field_validation.message: All-field independent-label gate passed; adjudicate disagreements.

full_field_model.final_performance_claim: held-out diagnostic only; retain this run's baseline SHA-256 and do not tune further.
full_field_model.next_step: Do not tune the model after releasing held-out results.

causal_analysis.design: Retrospective, lagged observational association with macro controls, outcome persistence, calendar seasonality, HAC(6) intervals, and a future-media placebo.
causal_analysis.primary_exposure: Previous-calendar-month negative-tone share; coefficients are reported per 10 percentage-point increase.
causal_analysis.placebo_test: Future-month negative tone is included as a reverse-timing placebo; a nonzero placebo is evidence against a simple directional media interpretation, not evidence for causality when null.
causal_analysis.subindex_timing: 2010-2025 subindices are annual-report historical backfills. They are valid final-value outcomes for this retrospective association but not a real-time availability claim.
not_identified: Respondent-level exposure, selection into media consumption, and changes in individual beliefs.
A causal effect of media tone on the national Michigan index.
Confounding by economic shocks, publisher/audience demand, political events, or unmeasured household conditions.
causal_analysis.next_identification_step: Use the documented randomized truthful-framing experiment with consent, pre-registered outcomes, source-blind stimuli, and required instructor/IRB approval before fielding.

source_benchmark.method: Pairs source strata within publication-day and pre-specified salience-topic cells; reports unweighted matched-cell contrasts.
source_benchmark.scope: Content supply only. This benchmark does not establish bias, represent audience exposure, or identify causal effects.

macro_refresh.vintage_status: current revised values only; not an ALFRED historical-vintage panel

failures.error: direct/licensed source required; no public FRED identifier registered
direct/licensed source required; no public FRED identifier registered

metadata.real_time_vintage_note: The primary ALFRED model uses initial-release values available by each documented Michigan final-release date. Dates are reliable at day precision, not intraday ordering.

survey_subgroups.message: Age-group ICS source rows are loaded separately. Verified subgroup ICC/ICE components are frozen at 2026-02: the public archive query YYYYMM(202603-202608) returned no records on 2026-10-14, and the archive production rule has not yet been validated against Table 1B. March–August 2026 are pending archive or producer release.
